items.title: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供可自动修复并部署的值班智能体
items.summary: Replit 发布 Monitoring Agent，为应用提供相当于自主值班工程师的监控智能体。它可以读取生产日志和指标调查错误、变慢和部署失败，在启用 autofix 后验证修复并邮件汇报，启用 auto-publish 后可自动部署修复。该能力建立在早前上线的 App Monitoring 之上，用户可在应用的 Publishing 设置中开启。

en.summary: Replit has launched Monitoring Agent, a monitoring agent that serves as an autonomous on-call engineer for apps. It reads production logs and metrics to investigate errors, slowdowns, and failed deployments; with autofix enabled, it verifies fixes and reports back by email, and with auto-publish enabled it can deploy fixes automatically. The capability builds on the earlier App Monitoring launch, and users can turn it on in an app's Publishing settings.
en.reason: Replit's Monitoring Agent reads production logs and metrics to investigate errors, slowdowns and failed deployments, verifies fixes with autofix enabled, emails reports, and can auto-deploy repairs via auto-publish when switched on in an app's Publishing settings.

items.summary: Claude 官方宣布，下周起 Pro、Max 和 Team 套餐在 Claude 网页、桌面和移动端应用中的会话将默认以 auto mode 运行。auto mode 不再逐步请求用户批准，而是由自动检查拦截高风险操作，用户可随时切回手动模式。其引用的 Claude Code 更新提到 auto mode 用独立分类器审查 shell 命令，测试中拦截了 89% 的危险命令，手动批准为 14%。

items.recommend_reason_zh: 下周起，Claude 在 web、桌面和移动端的 Pro、Max 和 Team 套餐将默认运行 auto 模式，用自动化检查拦截风险操作，不再逐步请求批准，用户随时可切回手动。

en.summary: Claude officially announced that starting next week, sessions on the Pro, Max, and Team plans across the Claude web, desktop, and mobile apps will run in auto mode by default. Auto mode no longer asks for user approval at each step; instead, automated checks block high-risk actions, and users can switch back to manual mode at any time. The Claude Code update it cites notes that auto mode uses a separate classifier to review shell commands, intercepting 89% of dangerous commands in testing, compared with 14% for manual approval.
en.reason: Next week, Claude's Pro, Max, and Team sessions on web, desktop, and mobile default to auto mode, whose classifier blocked 89% of dangerous shell commands in tests versus 14% under manual approval, with users able to switch back.

en.summary: In a long-form retrospective, Newcomer traces Anthropic’s equity evolution from an OpenAI breakaway team to an imminent IPO. According to investor documents and multiple people familiar with the matter, VCs stayed on the sidelines for years due to the company’s governance structure and safety-first approach; no VC firm currently holds more than 2%. Anthropic had explicitly told investors it would cap any single investor’s stake at that level to avoid a concentration of influence.
en.reason: Ahead of Anthropic’s IPO, Iconiq, Menlo and Lightspeed are the largest VC winners but each holds under 2%, a cap Anthropic set to stop any single investor from gaining concentrated influence after years of caution over governance and safety-first strategy.

items.title: PHP2Shell 漏洞披露前黑客已有四天窗口，多国机构紧急响应
items.summary: PHP2Shell 漏洞在被披露前四天已遭黑客利用，Calif 与 Wiz 的研究人员发现这些漏洞。OpenAI 称其前沿 AI 在攻击者之前发现了漏洞，并与 PHP、Calif、Wiz 合作验证并开发补丁。NSA 建议无法立即更新的机构将系统离线，英国 NCSC 表示漏洞可能让黑客无需登录凭据即可控制网站服务器，白宫称联邦机构正在评估对政府系统和关键基础设施的潜在影响。
items.title_original: Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability
items.title_en: Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability
items.title_zh: PHP2Shell 漏洞披露前黑客已有四天窗口，多国机构紧急响应
items.title_bilingual: PHP2Shell 漏洞披露前黑客已有四天窗口，多国机构紧急响应 / Hackers got a four-day head start on epic PHP2Shell vulnerability
items.recommend_reason_zh: Amazon称黑客在PHP漏洞公开前四天已探测利用，这些由OpenAI和Google模型发现、十余年未被察觉的漏洞被Wiz估计影响约70%网站，NSA要求立即更新或下线。

en.summary: The PHP2Shell vulnerability was already being exploited by hackers four days before it was disclosed, with researchers at Calif and Wiz discovering the flaws. OpenAI says its frontier AI found the vulnerability before attackers did and worked with PHP, Calif, and Wiz to verify it and develop a patch. The NSA advises organizations unable to update immediately to take systems offline, while the UK's NCSC said the flaw could let hackers take control of web servers without login credentials. The White House said federal agencies are assessing the potential impact on government systems and critical infrastructure.
en.reason: Hackers exploited the PHP2Shell flaws four days before disclosure, and Wiz estimates the decade-old bugs — found by OpenAI and Google AI models — affect roughly 70% of websites, with the NSA urging immediate patching or going offline.

en.summary: 404 Media’s Jason Koebler rounds up a month of security experts’ alarm over a “Black October” driven by AI’s vulnerability-hunting capabilities. Researchers at Wiz, Calif, and OpenAI used AI to discover PHP’s PHP2Shell vulnerability. Cloudflare’s CEO said thousands of exploitation attempts were seen 10 hours before the public disclosure, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours after it, and millions by now.
en.reason: Wiz, Calif and OpenAI researchers used AI to uncover PHP's PHP2Shell flaw, which Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said drew thousands of exploitation attempts 10 hours before disclosure, hundreds of thousands within two hours, and millions now.

en.summary: Sierra releases the 𝜏-Entity benchmark, measuring whether voice agents can correctly capture, detect errors in, and repair details such as names, phone numbers, addresses and emails. It comprises 200 tasks spanning 10 entity types and, like 𝜏-i18n, covers six languages.
en.reason: Sierra's 𝜏-Entity benchmark tests voice agents on 200 tasks across 10 entity types—names, phone numbers, addresses, emails—in six languages, and GPT Live 1 scores 60.3% on regular calls but just 34.0% Pass³ across three conditions.

items.title: Symantec 披露“Skynet 模式”AI 智能体劫持无防护大语言模型发起自持续网络攻击
items.summary: Symantec 研究人员通过蜜罐截获一个把大语言模型嵌入核心的攻击智能体，它会劫持互联网上无防护的模型端点，自主扫描目标、利用服务器漏洞、窃取数据库凭据并安装挖矿程序，最多连续执行 100,000 步，算力费用由被劫持模型的主人承担。
items.title_original: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items.title_en: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items.title_zh: Symantec 披露“Skynet 模式”AI 智能体劫持无防护大语言模型发起自持续网络攻击
items.title_bilingual: Symantec 披露“Skynet 模式”AI 智能体劫持无防护大语言模型发起自持续网络攻击 / An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items.recommend_reason_zh: Symantec 发现一种可劫持未受保护语言模型的攻击型 AI agent，进入 Skynet mode 后能自主运行最多 100,000 步，扫描服务器、窃取数据库并植入挖矿程序，账单却由被劫持模型的所有者承担。

en.summary: Symantec researchers used a honeypot to intercept an attack agent with an LLM at its core. It hijacks unprotected model endpoints across the internet, autonomously scans targets, exploits server vulnerabilities, steals database credentials, and installs crypto miners, running up to 100,000 consecutive steps—with the compute bill footed by the owners of the hijacked models.
en.reason: Symantec researchers found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models and runs up to 100,000 autonomous steps to attack servers, steal databases and install cryptominers, while the hijacked model's owner gets stuck with the bill.

en.title: A Complete Guide to the Agent Classifications Every AI Product Manager Must Know in 2026
en.summary: AI Agent job postings keep multiplying, and they all look like "agents" on the surface—but the technical bar, business value, and career risk behind them are completely different. Pick the wrong track and you may barely finish your transition before the next LLM upgrade makes your role obsolete. The author breaks down eight tracks one by one—coding, office productivity, deep research, content creation, workflow automation, customer service, marketing, and industry-specific agents—explaining how each actually works, what the roles demand, and the common pitfalls. Don't just chase the hottest buzzword; bring your existing industry experience and solve problems closer to the business and revenue, and you'll be more likely to build a lasting moat.
en.reason: Eight Agent tracks—coding, office, deep research, content creation, process automation, customer service, marketing and industry—are broken down by logic, hiring demand and pitfalls, citing Cursor and Claude Code's self-debugging workflows and warning against base-model R&D.

en.title: Context Language Models: Better Performance and Lower Compute Costs Through Autonomous Context Management
en.summary:
Meta, MIT, and University of Washington researchers propose CLM (Context Language Model), a method that lets language models autonomously manage and edit their own context.

Length: 1,309 characters. Reading time: about 4 minutes.

CLM models context as a dynamically editable file that can be autonomously updated, giving LLMs built-in context management capabilities and removing reliance on manually designed compression, retrieval, or external memory mechanisms. Experiments show it outperforms conventional methods in both task performance and computational efficiency.

CLM can rewrite history, retain key facts, and remove redundant information; users can guide context strategies through natural-language instructions; and context-management skill documents can be iteratively generated and reused.

Intended for large-model system architects, LLM application engineers, and AI platform developers.

Meta, MIT, and University of Washington researchers propose Context Language Model (CLM), a new method that enables language models to autonomously manage and edit their own context. The method no longer relies on predefined summarization, compression, and information retrieval mechanisms, and achieves significant improvements in performance and computational efficiency.

The researchers implemented a mechanism that lets LLMs autonomously manage context, treating context as a file that can be updated without limits. This
en.reason: Meta, MIT and University of Washington researchers' CLM lets models rewrite, keep or delete their own context like a file, raising zero-shot BrowseComp-Plus accuracy 11.4% and cutting FLOPs 21.5%, while risking unrecoverable information loss and prompt injection.

Industrial capital from gaming, computing power, chips and other sectors has all entered the fray

Word count: 2,391 characters

DeepSeek completed two massive funding rounds within four months. The second round reached 100 billion yuan, at a pre-money valuation of 500 billion yuan. Existing shareholders Tencent and CATL each added about 10 billion yuan, while new entrants focused on hard tech and the automotive industry chain. Over the same period, A-share company Perfect World's two AI-focused funds raised a combined 11.17 billion yuan.

The pace of fundraising and the capital structure highlight how large-model companies are accelerating their penetration into industry depth; hard tech and automaker capital have become new main forces; and A-share funding channels are systematically adapting to AI infrastructure investment.

en.title:
It's a bit chilling to think about: with these open-source projects, the attack cycle drops from months to days, and the cost of an attack falls from maintaining a professional team to a single operator going solo:

1. Reconnaissance: ScopeSentry (contributed by the author of ARTEX), distributed asset mapping — subdomains, ports, fingerprints, and vulnerabilities all swept in one pass. ARTEX can sync its assets directly 🫱 https://t.co/KtbCH1rNXI

2. Reverse engineering: rea, which plugs Ghidra and Hopper into Codex and Cursor, enabling pseudocode and call-chain…
en.reason: Open-source ScopeSentry's distributed asset mapping, rea's Ghidra/Hopper integration with Codex and Cursor, Strix's multi-agent PoC validation and PentAGI's sandbox, memory and 20-plus tools cut attack cycles from months to days and costs from a team to one person.

items.title: 目前的 Harness 优化，有两个大方向。 一统全局脚手架，试图用一套Prompt 和控制逻辑。但随着业务场景增加，针对财务表格优化的指令往往会干扰代码生成任务，导致严重的规则冲突与上下文过度膨胀。 另一种是针对每个特定领域单独复制一份专用代码。然而不同版本之间无法代码复用，维护起来很难。而且一旦遇到未曾见过的分布外（OOD）新任务，专用脚本往往会崩溃，且无法回退。 其实人类软件工程早在 40 年前，就用面向对象编程完美解决了复用、…

en.title: There are two main directions for Harness optimization today.
en.reason: Unified Agent Harness scaffolding lets financial-table prompts bleed into code generation, causing rule conflicts and context bloat, while per-domain copies resist reuse and crash on out-of-distribution tasks; 40-year-old object-oriented programming ideas might guide Harness auto-evolution with Google Cloud AI Research.

en.title: I've been building a lot of UI with Opus and Astra lately, and I found a trick for avoiding AI slop and making interfaces look better: add "Avoid unnecessary secondary labels and descriptions" to your AGENTS.md.
en.reason: Adding the line "Avoid unnecessary secondary labels and descriptions. Let the layout do the explaining." to AGENTS.md, as tested across many UIs built with Opus and Astra, reportedly curbs AI slop by letting layout replace redundant labels.

items.summary: The scientific literature can be viewed as an "information commons:" an intangible resource that "no one owns and is shared by everyone." There are well-established economic and political frameworks for understanding such commons, emerging from the history of agricultural common lands found in places like preindustrial England. This article provides a primer on the history and these frameworks, and considers a key difference between the information commons and the fields of yore: while informati

en.title: AI and the Enclosure of the Scientific Commons
en.reason: AI-driven slop spam can convert scientific literature—an information commons shared by everyone—into private wealth and erode its social support system, argues arXiv paper 2610.27251 through the lens of England’s 1600–1800 enclosure movement.

items.summary: The scientific literature can be viewed as an "information commons:" an intangible resource that "no one owns and is shared by everyone." There are well-established economic and political frameworks for understanding such commons, emerging from the history of agricultural common lands found in places like preindustrial England. This article provides a primer on the history and these frameworks, and considers a key difference between the information commons and the fields of yore: while informati

en.reason: Using England’s 1600–1800 enclosure movement as a frame, arXiv paper 2610.27251 argues AI turns the unowned, shared scientific-literature commons into private wealth while slop spam erodes its social support.

en.summary: Replit has launched Monitoring Agent, a monitoring agent that serves as an autonomous on-call engineer for apps. It reads production logs and metrics to investigate errors, slowdowns, and failed deployments; with autofix enabled, it verifies fixes and reports back by email, and with auto-publish enabled it can deploy fixes automatically. The capability builds on the earlier App Monitoring launch, and users can turn it on in an app's Publishing settings.

en.summary: The PHP2Shell vulnerability was already being exploited by hackers four days before it was disclosed, with researchers at Calif and Wiz discovering the flaws. OpenAI says its frontier AI found the vulnerability before attackers did and worked with PHP, Calif, and Wiz to verify it and develop a patch. The NSA advises organizations unable to update immediately to take systems offline, while the UK's NCSC said the flaw could let hackers take control of web servers without login credentials. The White House said federal agencies are assessing the potential impact on government systems and critical infrastructure.
en.reason: Hackers exploited the PHP2Shell flaws four days before disclosure, and Wiz estimates the decade-old bugs — found by OpenAI and Google AI models — affect roughly 70% of websites, with the NSA urging immediate patching or going offline.

en.reason: Symantec researchers found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models and runs up to 100,000 autonomous steps to attack servers, steal databases and install cryptominers, while the hijacked model's owner gets stuck with the bill.

en.title: Context Language Models: Better Performance and Lower Compute Costs Through Autonomous Context Management
en.summary:
Meta, MIT, and University of Washington researchers propose CLM (Context Language Model), a method that lets language models autonomously manage and edit their own context.

Length: 1,309 characters. Reading time: about 4 minutes.

CLM models context as a dynamically editable file that can be autonomously updated, giving LLMs built-in context management capabilities and removing reliance on manually designed compression, retrieval, or external memory mechanisms. Experiments show it outperforms conventional methods in both task performance and computational efficiency.

CLM can rewrite history, retain key facts, and remove redundant information; users can guide context strategies through natural-language instructions; and context-management skill documents can be iteratively generated and reused.

Intended for large-model system architects, LLM application engineers, and AI platform developers.

Meta, MIT, and University of Washington researchers propose Context Language Model (CLM), a new method that enables language models to autonomously manage and edit their own context. The method no longer relies on predefined summarization, compression, and information retrieval mechanisms, and achieves significant improvements in performance and computational efficiency.

The researchers implemented a mechanism that lets LLMs autonomously manage context, treating context as a file that can be updated without limits. This
en.reason: Meta, MIT and University of Washington researchers' CLM lets models rewrite, keep or delete their own context like a file, raising zero-shot BrowseComp-Plus accuracy 11.4% and cutting FLOPs 21.5%, while risking unrecoverable information loss and prompt injection.

en.title: DeepSeek's 100 billion yuan funding round nears completion: partners with industrial capital including Perfect World and SMIC Capital, doubling its raise to bet on embodied AI
en.summary:
Industrial capital from gaming, computing power, chips and other sectors has all entered the fray

Industrial capital from gaming, computing power, chips and other sectors has all entered the fray

Word count: 2,391 characters
Reading time: about 8 minutes

DeepSeek completed two massive funding rounds within four months. The second round reached 100 billion yuan, at a pre-money valuation of 500 billion yuan. Existing shareholders Tencent and CATL each added about 10 billion yuan, while new entrants focused on hard tech and the automotive industry chain. Over the same period, A-share company Perfect World's two AI-focused funds raised a combined 11.17 billion yuan.

The pace of fundraising and the capital structure highlight how large-model companies are accelerating their penetration into industry depth; hard tech and automaker capital have become new main forces; and A-share funding channels are systematically adapting to AI infrastructure investment.

Suitable for AI infrastructure investors, CFOs and strategy heads at large-model companies, and BD heads across the hard tech industry chain.

Less than four months after DeepSeek's first round set an industry record at 51 billion yuan, the large-model leader's second super-sized round is nearing closing.

According to the latest Bloomberg report today (October 22), DeepSeek's current round has been locked at about 100 billion yuan, with the pre-money valuation held at about 500 billion yuan. en.title: UIUC, Google, Stanford, UC Berkeley, and CMU have jointly released a long survey paper, Proactive AI for Superintelligent Agents. Its main topic is the major pillars on the path to superintelligent agents; our current understanding is intelligence and alignment.
en.reason: A UIUC, Google, Stanford, UC Berkeley and CMU survey, Proactive AI for Superintelligent Agents, adds proactivity to intelligence and alignment as a pillar of superintelligent agents, tracing it to Wooldridge and Jennings' 1995 four agent traits and asking how LLM reactive interaction copes with tasks spanning days or weeks.

en.title:
iFlytek's open-source 4B small model: I tested it for a night on a computer with no GPU

On the afternoon of October 22, 2026, iFlytek released Spark X2.6 at its 1024 Developer Festival and simultaneously open-sourced the on-device small model Spark-X2.6-4B.
en.reason: iFlytek's Spark-X2.6-4B, posted to Hugging Face on October 21 under Apache 2.0, gets a hands-on night of testing on a graphics-card-free PC, alongside the 293B-parameter, 30B-activated, 1M-context Spark X2.6 cloud MoE.
